description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120); X(id LONG, k LONG) with 8 rows (k = 10, 20, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70), then CREATE INDEX IX_K ON X (k). DELETE the row with k = 10 (id 1). Then TableDefs.Refresh and IX_K's DistinctCount; Close; the bytes of pages 40 to 43 (X's TableDef) are read from the closed file and kept. Asks how word0 and word1 of a bulk-built index's counter block move.
